bullets: Led Lightkeeper from concepts and pitching through funded high-concept and prototype stages to a playable vertical slice, shaping game design, UI/UX, progression, level design, prototyping, and production.
Created pitch-deck and game-design documentation; worked on writing, world building, map layouts, content creation, and marketing for the vertical slice.
Design and prototype KERN’s investigative gameplay systems, tools, and interfaces directly in-engine, iterating interaction details through hands-on use.
Redesign and implement Flax editor workflows, UI, and interface feedback, with selected changes contributed upstream.
Wrote, directed, produced, and edited Daedalus Alpha, coordinating a 12-person film production from planning and pitching through the shoot and final delivery.
Wrote the story and built the world for an interactive science-fiction comic.
Generated 9,000 source images and edited the material into a coherent narrative.
Animated 12 panels in Rive and built the web reading experience with a licensed soundtrack.
Developed the brand and merchandise product line with collaborators.
Directed, pitched, produced, and edited Daedalus Alpha.
Led day-to-day production on Dronies across nine design and development teams, involving roughly 30 contributors.
Coordinated priorities and delivery with Solana Labs, and developed the plan for a marketing campaign. The project generated approximately US$3M in sales.
Developed product strategy, UX concepts, interaction design, and design systems for technology and healthcare clients, including UserWise and Merck.
Led UI/UX redesign work for Bolt 2.0, producing UX documentation and high-fidelity mockups.
Created 278 icons for Unity API functions, exported them into the engine, and iterated on their appearance in context.
The commissioned Bolt work later became part of Unity Visual Scripting after Unity acquired Bolt from Ludiq.
Designed chatbot and web-app experiences, including onboarding and interaction flows, and supported a Product Hunt launch.
Researched users, developed personas, and produced wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity UI mockups.
Prototyped interactions in Figma and Framer.
Designed and developed brand websites, translating requirements into information architecture, interaction flows, visual design, and web implementation.
Worked on websites for brands including Toyota, Remington, Christie Cookies Co, and Carhartt.
Produced wireframes and designs in Sketch and Photoshop, with UX documentation and information-architecture documents for design and development teams.
